purpose: One bounded tuning pass separating corrected current-event disocclusion from conservative persistent-history rejection.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged during Matrix 24. Mode 14 corrected event veto only; mode 15 additionally preserved compensated intrinsic residual while raw disocclusion still drove history and motion bypass.
interpretation: Mode 15 is the first candidate to pass the complete Matrix 24 hard contract: replay SUCCESS, <=70 ms clearing, >=0.45 moving-flash reduction, >=0.70 perceptual reduction, WCAG 2.3.1/2.3.2, and pan MAE <=0.010. Mode 14 also passes with substantially more pan margin but lower moving-flash suppression. Per the bounded-experiment rule, no further parameter tuning is performed before human visual validation; mode 15 is promoted only on branch test.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
